chapter: World's Greatest Jazz Band and Denver
title: Working with Stan Getz
summary: He worked with Getz at the Bohemian Club before Getz went to Europe.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution

blocks.x: Have you worked much with Stan Getz?
Yeah, I worked with Stan Getz at the Behemian Club there in New York.
Oh. Was he -- was that before he went to Europe?
Yeah, before he went to Europe.
Was he hard to get along with then?
Oh, not to me, but he was kind of messed up.
But I got along with him fine.
But you haven't played with him since.
No, not since we did a jam session together. And that's been about ten years ago or something like that.
Well, Dick hasn't had him out to the party.
